## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, and stolid twenty-year-old youth. He has a round, expressionless face and demonstrates a painful lack of conversational gifts.

## History

Billy Andrews drove [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane to a concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Anne](../character/anne.md) overcame stage fright to deliver a highly praised recitation. Following her successful encore and a supper with the group, Billy drove the girls back home. During the ride, the girls conversed about the wealthy hotel guests, leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reflect on her contentment with her own life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P11](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII.
